visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit studio with a colorful cartoon-style background poster. A man in a white button-down shirt is seated on the floor, holding a children's book. He interacts with another man in a striped shirt and scarf who is crouching, holding green and orange dinosaur toys. The man in white speaks with a calm facial expression, while the man in stripes exhibits exaggerated angry and stubborn facial expressions, shaking the toys. Comic-style overlays like anger symbols, smoke puffs, and lightning bolts appear around the men. (2) The man in white then speaks directly to the camera, assuming a teacher-like persona. He gestures with his hands to emphasize points. The video cuts between him explaining and brief reenactments with the man in stripes. Red checkmarks and stylized text banners appear at the top to highlight specific parenting tips. The man in stripes acts confused or contemplative, sometimes with a cartoon bird or swirl icon above his head. (3) The background changes to a dark, minimalist setting with white text crawling upwards. A circular inset shows the man in white continuing his explanation. He holds up the book titled '為什麼要說對不起' towards the end. The final frame is a clean white screen with social media icons and call-to-action text.

(2) A sharp 'smoke puff' SFX triggers, followed by Male Voice 2 shouting in a high-pitched, whiny tone. (3) A fire crackling SFX layers over the music as the voices continue an exaggerated argumentative skit. (4) A camera shutter SFX and a lightning strike SFX punctuate a transition; Male Voice 2's arousal levels peak in a loud scream. (5) Cartoon crying SFX and sobbing vocals are mixed over a rhythmic drum beat. (6) A 'ding' SFX signals a shift to a professional tutorial tone; Male Voice 1 enunciates parenting tips with high clarity. (7) 'Crow caw' SFX and 'boing' sound effects are used to highlight confusion and reactions. (8) At the 01:05 mark, the BGM shifts abruptly to a sentimental, soft piano track. (9) Voice 1 adopts a warm, low-arousal narrative style. The video concludes with a final digital mouse click SFX.
